Amin Tavassolian <amin.tavassolian@avicennaresearch.com>:
Tuesday, September 24, 2024 8:40 AM To: Chung, Jane <jane.chung@emory.edu> Subject: [External] Re. the RAMS study Dear Jane, I hope you are doing well. I wanted to follow up on my previous email regarding our collaboration on the RAMS study, and the value Avicenna can bring to your team. We already have worked with more than 3,000 researchers from more than 100 universities, and we consistently see using an app for participants as part of the research leads to higher participant retention, more engagement, and higher data quality. That's why I genuinely believe our tool could greatly contribute to your upcoming research as well. You can learn more about our work in this Google Sheets file. Please let me know if you are available for a brief chat or demo, and what time might work for you in the following days. Also if you don't want to hear from me, just reply and let me know. Warm regards, Amin P.S: I include my initial email just in case you've missed it: Dear Jane, My name is Amin from Avicenna Research, a Canadian health-research software company. I recently learned about your impressive five-year research project focused on life-space and activity digital markers for detection of cognitive decline in community-dwelling older adults, which has secured a grant. Congratulations! That certainly talks about the merits of the project. I am reaching out to explore any potential collaboration opportunities, as I genuinely believe we can help you with this study. We enable researchers to quickly set up participant-facing apps and websites for health and psychology studies. Specifically, our software can help with: Comprehensive Data Collection: Gather GPS and wrist actigraphy data Longitudinal Study Management: Support extended data collection and regular evaluations User Engagement Tools: Maintain high participant compliance with notifications and prompts Integration of Diverse Data Sources: Handle sensor data, self-reported activities, social health factors, and cognitive assessments Mixed-Methods Research: Facilitate qualitative data collection with surveys and questionnaires Here you can find our slide deck with more details on our software. We have worked with many researchers on various topics in health and longitudinal studies across diverse demographics (check our publication track record here). I'm sure we can bring value to your research as well, and form a long-lasting partnership for all of your upcoming work. Would you be open to a brief call or a demo to explore this further? You can check my calendar here and pick a time that works best for you. Thank you for your time, Jane. Looking forward to speaking with you. Best regards, Amin -------- Amin Tavassolian ( My Calendar) Solutions Architect Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data) 4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: amin.tavassolian@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com------

Hi Jane,It was nice talking to you yesterday as well.Regarding your question, we do have this data source, called "Call Logs" and "SMS Logs". They provide the following data fields: - User ID - Device type - Contact phone number - Length (characters in SMS or duration in phone calls) - Type (incoming, outgoing, missed, etc.)And they are available in both Android and iOS. The caveat is that due to sensitivity of this information, our stock app does not have permissions to collect this data. If your study needs to collect this data, we would need to create a branded application for your study, submit it to the App Store and Google Play along with Ethics Approval that confirms the requirements for collecting such that, and then we can collect it. We can take care of everything on our end of course, just wanted to share why you may not see this in our Learn documentation.Hope it helps,Amin--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Tuesday, October 8, 2024 at 10:12:41 AM,
